manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp439-445 says a blank APID leaves MaintenanceAllocation policy unfiltered and APID selects the POINT solution in StockAllocation, ResourceAllocation and MaintenanceAllocation. It does not clearly establish the stock effect when APID is blank and two stock POINTs conflict. The native pair will measure that boundary.
source_delta: Selected arm is byte-identical to accepted I01.var01 stocked source with AIR_BASIC STSIZ1 and AIR_EMPTY STSIZ0 for the same IID/STID. Child changes only Control.APID from AIR_BASIC to null (blank) and ProblemDescription. Both have identical aircraft, LRU failure, explicit replacement, item repair, fixed three missions, seed1 and horizon36. ResourceAllocation is empty and MaintenanceAllocation absent.

pre_run_hypotheses.selected: Reproduce accepted I01.var01 stocked event/stock/system behavior, including one local spare taken at h10 and readiness h10.5.
pre_run_hypotheses.blank: Native import may reject blank APID with two stock POINTs, select no stock, combine or select a POINT, or use a default. None is preaccepted. If simulation succeeds, inspect initial stock, physical issue/backorder, event timeline, 72-bin System/Stock ledgers and terminal state before characterizing behavior.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter errors, duplicate stock effects, shifted failure draw, unsealed output or report inconsistency remain diagnostic until explained. The manual's maintenance no-filter statement must not be generalized to stock without native evidence.
